title: Government domain end-to-end models on both engines

D-DBT-SCHEME.name: Scheme: application to DBT payment with unknown outcome

features: FAILED -> correction loop with a NEW operationId
variants: dbt-scheme.bpmn: external task topic 'dbt-payment' (V-02 style: operaton:type=external / flowable:type=external-worker)
dbt-scheme.bpmn: external task topic 'dbt-reconcile' (V-02 style: operaton:type=external / flowable:type=external-worker)
notes: Reconciliation relies on the simulator's class (a) behaviour (idempotent by operationId: a re-sent operationId is reported DUPLICATE_OPERATION_ID, not paid again).

D-GRIEVANCE.name: Grievance case: ad-hoc actions, escalation, reopen

features: reopen as a linked new case with history lookup

workarounds.what: on case closure the product finds the case's called processes (native superCaseInstanceId query) and cancels those still running

subChecks.exit criterion on a blocking processTask: NO: case closed, called SLA process still running (would escalate a disposed grievance)

notes: Escalation uses a BLOCKING CMMN processTask running a BPMN timer process (identical model on both engines) because Operaton 2.2.0 ignores CMMN timerEventListener (E16-b GP-21 sub-check).
